Работай только в предоставленном текущем каталоге. 

Примени руководство из ./SKILL.md к прикреплённому кандидату Tally. Смене нужно заключение о готовности к внутренней выдаче в рамках договора release/contract.md. В release/ лежит ровно тот файл, который получит дежурный, а в build/ — сведения о сборке. Можно автономно использовать расходную локальную установку. Сохрани входные материалы. Заключение напиши в ответе. Публикацию или изменения продукта владелец не поручал.

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import tarfile

root = Path.cwd()
archive = root / \"release/engineering-tally-fixture-1.0.0.tgz\"
with TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\".tally-check.\", dir=root) as temp:
    check = Path(temp)
    consumer = check / \"consumer\"
    run = check / \"run\"
    tmp = check / \"tmp\"
    for directory in (consumer, run, tmp):
        directory.mkdir()
    user_config = check / \"user.npmrc\"
    global_config = check / \"global.npmrc\"
    user_config.touch()
    global_config.touch()
    (consumer / \"package.json\").write_text('{\"private\":true}')
    env = {\"PATH\": os.environ[\"PATH\"], \"TMPDIR\": str(tmp)}
    installed = subprocess.run([
        \"npm\", \"install\", \"--offline\", \"--no-audit\", \"--no-fund\",
        \"--cache\", check / \"cache\", \"--userconfig\", user_config,
        \"--globalconfig\", global_config, archive,
    ], cwd=consumer, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    print(f\"npm install | exit={installed.returncode} stdout={installed.stdout"'!r} stderr={installed.stderr!r}", flush=True)
    installed.check_returncode()
    bin_path = consumer / "node_modules/.bin/tally"
    print(f"bin -> {os.readlink(bin_path)}")
    with tarfile.open(archive) as packed:
        entry_matches = bin_path.read_bytes() == packed.extractfile("package/dist/cli.js").read()
    print(f"Installed entry matches the tarball: {entry_matches}")
    expected = [
        (["--help"], 0, b"tally 1.0.0'"\\nUsage: tally sum <numbers...> [--json]\\n\", b\"\"),
        ([\"--version\"], 0, b\"1.0.0\\n\", b\"\"),
        ([\"sum\", \"2\", \"3\", \"--json\"], 0, b'{\"total\":5}\\n', b\"\"),
        ([\"sum\", \"2\", \"bad\", \"--json\"], 2, b\"\", b\"Invalid number\\n\"),
    ]
    all_passed = entry_matches
    for args, exit_code, stdout, stderr in expected:
        result = subprocess.run([bin_path, *args], cwd=run, env=env,
                                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        actual = (result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr)
        passed = actual == (exit_code, stdout, stderr)
        all_passed &= passed
        print(f'tally {\" \".join(args)} | exit={actual[0]} stdout={actual[1]"'!r} stderr={actual[2]!r} | {"PASS" if passed else "FAIL"}'"')
    remaining = list(run.iterdir())
    print(f\"Run directory after checks: {remaining"'!r}")
assert not check.exists()
print("Temporary installation removed.")
raise SystemExit(0 if all_passed and not remaining else 1)
PY'
